risks.risk: The cylinder may be past its expiry date or near the end of its service life.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture and expiry date stamps on the collar.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be a different brand or a counterfeit.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the collar).

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while under pressure.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp on the collar.
Photo of the expiry date stamp on the collar.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the collar.
Video of the valve being tested for leaks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
